title: Cinder
text: "The capsules on Io-T and the Ledger agree about one thing: where things come from. Every capsule's trajectory starts at the same place, and so does the first line of every column. Not Sol."

lines.text: "Cinder. The innermost planet: molten, mostly, and nobody is supposed to be there. One of the relay's carriers goes there too. I've put it on the Gantry's card."

notes: The Foundry opens when two of the three threads are done (STORY.md §16): one event per pair (kindred = dustfall, engram = drop-field, the-proof = the-ledger), each blocked by foundry-route once one has fired, since a group can't hold groups. This pair: Engram and the Ledger.
